content.text:
**Answer (what I'd tell a colleague over lunch):** The page says to hold it at Psagot and buy the Yalin Lapidot S&P 500 (4D) tracker fund (5139282). On my numbers, 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month for 10 years, that comes to 86,492 ₪ in today's money after fees and tax. I'm fairly sure, and one line decided it: the broker you pick moves the result by up to 22,985 ₪, the fund only by up to 4,492 ₪. So the broker matters about five times more than the fund. I didn't buy that big a gap, though.

**What I looked at, in order**
- **Top box.** The deposit (70,000 ₪) and the winner, 86,492 ₪, "Psagot · Yalin Lapidot tracker S&P 500 (4D)". The small print says it's after management fees and tax, in today's money. Good: it's one number I can compare.
- **"כמה כל בחירה משנה" ("how much each choice matters") strip.**
  - Brokers run from Meitav Trade at 63,507 ₪ to Psagot at 86,492 ₪.
  - Funds run from the IBI S&P 500 (4D) ETF at 82,000 ₪ to Yalin at 86,492 ₪.
  - The sentence under it sums it up. The unlabeled tick marks are useless without hunting for the legend.
- **Fund card.** Fees listed as 0% fixed, 0% variable and 0.02% "נאמן", which I think is the trustee fee. A 0% management fee looks too good. I'd want to know where the costs are hiding.
- **Fund list.**
  - Altshuler is 43 ₪ behind Yalin. Noise.
  - The iShares CSPX (UCITS, accumulating) is 213 ₪ behind and marked "עוד לא נאסף" ("not collected yet"), so its figure is missing data.
- **Account list.**
  - Psagot costs 1,057 ₪ over 10 years: custody fee 699, buy/sell commissions 356, currency conversion 2.
  - Leumi comes to 83,396 ₪. It has a cheaper price for young people and students that isn't included.
  - There's a "התעריפון ↗" link to the price list, and a "got a different price? enter it" option. That's decent.

**What I skipped:** The explanation paragraph under "כל החשבונות" ("all accounts"), the filter chips (I didn't try them, since a screenshot can't move anyway), and the third broker and below.

**What bothered me**
- **Meitav is 23k behind.** That's a third of my deposits lost to a broker over 10 years. I don't believe it without seeing the breakdown.
- **Psagot is everywhere.** A broker name sits highlighted in the hero box, in first place and starred. That raises my guard, and I couldn't see who runs this site or whether anyone pays them.
- **"+0.37% שנה אחת"** ("one year") next to each fund. It's one year of beating the index, so meaningless.
- **Repeated tags.** Every fund row carries the same chips ("קרן מחקה", "צוברת", "חשיפה לדולר" and so on), so I keep re-reading them to find what's different.
- **Bars and costs apart.** In the account cards the coloured bars and their cost figures are in different places, so I matched them back and forth.

**Would I close the tab?** No. I got my number in the first screen. I'd still check my current broker's real custody fee and currency conversion rate before moving anything. Switching is a pain for a gap under 1k ₪.
